Package: com.nikonpreset.usbprobe
Signer SHA-256: 04db0f9d3d76c9831a0778cfabc1a0aaab984e05398da16eb644950ccfa0ae31
Minimum API 26; compile/target API 35; JDK 17.
Manual Android packaging, javac, D8, zipalign and APK v2/v3 verification passed.

Fix:
Physical-phone installation of 0.3.1 revealed an initial-render crash on PKG110:
PhoneWindow.getInsetsController() dereferenced an uncreated DecorView. A null check
on the returned controller could not prevent the platform method's internal NPE.
MainActivity.render now creates/caches DecorView before either system-bar branch,
and obtains each API 30+ controller once with a null check. Legacy flags remain.
No protocol, preview-cache, photo-gesture or automatic-pagination logic changed.

Physical-phone installation:
OnePlus PKG110, Android 16, adb serial 286f0dba, owner user 0.
The user manually uninstalled the old version. Owner package state confirmed
installed=false, but the OEM system_clone user 10 retained the old signed package
(zero data inodes, notLaunched=true). Removed that residual per-user installation
with pm uninstall --user 10, then installed the new development-signed APK.
The intermediate 0.3.1 APK installed but crashed on launch; it was replaced by
0.3.2 using adb install --user 0 -r, which returned Success without uninstalling.
Verified versionName=0.3.2-beta, versionCode=14 and installed owner state=true.
SHA-256 of installed base.apk matches the delivered APK hash above.

Cold-start verification:
Force-stopped only this app and launched MainActivity as owner user 0.
am start -W returned Status: ok / LaunchState: COLD, TotalTime: 404 ms.
App PID 22469 remained alive, and MainActivity was topResumedActivity.
PID-filtered AndroidRuntime error log was empty on the follow-up check.
Captured and visually inspected .impeccable/review/phone-install-0.3.2-home.png
(1080x2376) from this installed APK; the preset-library empty state rendered.
The app was left open for the user. No camera import or camera network was used.

Scope:
The 7052 pure JVM checks and 49-photo synthetic emulator album review belong to
0.3.1 as recorded in its validation file; those suites/screenshots were not rerun
or relabeled as 0.3.2 evidence. This patch was verified by Android compilation,
APK signature/hash verification and the physical-phone cold-start check above.
Real-camera Wi-Fi compatibility, phone photo paging/viewing and camera writes
remain unverified. The original pre-0.3.0 signing key remains unavailable.
